mapper.select: SELECT id, name, type, radius_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(geom, 15) AS geometry_json FROM pipeline ORDER BY id

SELECT target.id AS target_id, target.name AS target_name, ST_3DDistance(source.geom, target.geom) AS center_distance_m, ST_3DDistance(source.geom, target.geom) - source.radius_m - target.radius_m AS clearance_m, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_3DShortestLine(source.geom, target.geom), 15) AS shortest_line_json FROM pipeline source JOIN pipeline target ON target.id != source.id WHERE source.id = #{id} ORDER BY clearance_m, target.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pipeline (name, type, radius_m, geom) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{radiusM}, ST_GeomFromText(#{geometryWkt}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE pipeline SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, radius_m = #{radiusM}, geom = ST_GeomFromText(#{geometryWkt}, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
